parsed.explanation: GE spun off both GE HealthCare (January 2023) and GE Vernova (2024), and the historical results of both businesses were recast as discontinued operations for all periods presented, removing their revenues from prior-year continuing operations figures.
parsed.evidence_quote: Results of operations, financial position and cash flows for these businesses are reported as discontinued operations for all periods presented and the notes to the financial statements have been adjusted on a retrospective basis.
